pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal regions with sub-angular to rounded vertices. Edges exhibit a soft pixel gradient transitioning from tan to cream. Spatial area of patches is heterogeneous across the visible flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous light-toned pathways forming a closed-loop network. Nodes are primarily three-way intersections. Pixel thickness of pathways is relatively uniform with minor narrowing at high-curvature nodes.
